name: From-scratch spectral-morph wavetable ambient pad
goal: Design an ambient pad by building a soft→complex wavetable (sine + harmonics, spectral blend, phase/warp), LFO-morphing WT position, dual filters with stereo-split randomization, long amp/filter envelopes, optional pitched-down sample texture, then compressor → dotted delay → long reverb (~10–11s) with bipolar random pans.

source.title: Ambient Pads in Vital From Scratch

prerequisites: Wavetable synth with WT editor (harmonics/phase/spectral blend), dual filters, sample osc, FX

inputs.name: sample_texture
inputs.description: Optional original Foley/noise sample pitched down

constraints: Ground every step in the source YouTube-provided captions; do not invent UI or settings.
Original synthesis only — map brand UI (Serum/Vital/Pigments/Phase Plant/etc.) to portable osc/filter/FX roles for a browser or generic hybrid synth; never rip presets, wavetables, or samples.
Prefer transferable signal-flow and motion relationships over vendor-specific preset names.
Build or use original wavetables; do not copy commercial bank tables named in the video.
Prefer 12 dB filter slopes for subtle ambient moves unless a steeper cut is intentional.

steps.action: In WT editor: start from sine; remove extra keyframes; add harmonics gradually; duplicate end frame; spectral-blend; alter phase/harmonics on the end frame so position morphs soft→complex.
Synced LFO (e.g. 4 bars) → wavetable position at high depth so the custom table evolves.
Second osc: draw/warp another shape; optional harmonic-stretch randomized slowly; unison with octave-stack mode at low detune (~3–4%).
Amp env ~4s attack / ~6s release; optional curve bend.
Dual filters (e.g. osc1 LP 12 dB, osc2 HP) with env→cutoff; randomize stereo-split/phase for width.
Optional sample osc: original garage/Foley texture pitched −1–2 octaves, low level.
steps.expect: Organic tickle above the pure synth

steps.action: FX: multiband compress for air → dotted delay with feedback → reverb time ~10–11s; bipolar random → pan on oscs for width.

verification: Wavetable was authored or clearly morphed, not a static stock saw only
Stereo motion from split and/or pan randomization
